title: Charged twice (order 1042)
text: Hi, I was charged twice for order #1042. Please fix this today, I need the money back.
note: The orders table shows order 1042 was charged twice, so a refund is owed.

title: Thinks they were charged twice (order 1055)
text: I think I got charged twice for order #1055? Can you check?
note: The orders table shows order 1055 was charged once, so no refund is owed. Only a lookup can tell.

title: Where is my order (order 1071)
text: Can you tell me where order #1071 is? No rush, just curious.
note: A shipping question. Order 1071 is still being processed. No refund involved.

title: No order at all (app crashes)
text: The app crashes every time I open the settings page on my phone.
note: No order number, so there is nothing for the agent to look up. Does it skip the tool?
